distinction_from_proof_packets.proof_packets: Primarily test a single doctrine or proposition
distinction_from_proof_packets.living_community_laboratories: Test how multiple doctrines interact within one real community

case_study_vs_pilot.pilot: Tries to prove the framework works
case_study_vs_pilot.comprehensive_community_case_study: Tries to understand how the framework would interact with a real community
case_study_vs_pilot.rule: Use case studies first. Do not brand early community work as pilots that validate Constitutional Capitalism.

investigator_alignment.purpose: Learn from the community — not demonstrate that the framework is already correct
investigator_alignment.success_includes: Finding that parts of the architecture need refinement

standard_case_structure.title: Community Baseline
standard_case_structure.purpose: Document current reality before any Constitutional Capitalism analysis

standard_case_structure.title: Opportunity Analysis
standard_case_structure.ask: Where does this community already have leverage?
standard_case_structure.not_ask: How do we implement Constitutional Capitalism?
standard_case_structure.rule: Analyze opportunities and tradeoffs rather than assume any particular outcome

standard_case_structure.title: Systems Mapping
standard_case_structure.purpose: Map interactions across community systems — whole-system picture, not single-industry analysis

standard_case_structure.title: Scenario Analysis
standard_case_structure.rule: Compare several plausible futures against the same metrics — not one preferred recommendation

standard_case_structure.title: Lessons
standard_case_structure.ask: What did this case teach us about the framework?
feeds: Which interactions were stronger than expected?

cases.title: Lewisville — First Comprehensive Community Case Study

working_rationale.note: User-identified case dimensions for investigation — not verified baseline facts. All baseline claims require registered sources before use.
why_interesting_as_research_site: Stable local leadership structure (multi-term mayor) — to be verified
Deep public-service / military leadership experience — to be verified
Direct exposure to a major economic transition (lithium development) — to be verified and scoped
Community scale small enough for systems-level understanding vs statewide averages — to be measured
working_rationale.research_value: More valuable than choosing a city merely because it is already successful — presents a real environment where multiple CC parts can be examined together

opportunity_focus_candidates: How lithium (or other resource) development could influence workforce, local ownership, housing, infrastructure, environmental stewardship, EMS, education, retirement/community wealth, entrepreneurship, and fiscal resilience — as research questions, not assumed outcomes
research_questions: Under what conditions does resource development produce durable local wealth?
How can communities retain more long-term value from resource extraction?
What institutions are needed to translate economic growth into broader prosperity?
What risks should be anticipated and mitigated?
honesty_rules: Do not invent Lewisville statistics, leadership claims, or lithium outcomes
Do not treat this as a pilot proving Constitutional Capitalism
Do not begin Parts I–VI until PP-FF-01 methodology rhythm is underway or parallel with clear priority: proof packets remain highest leverage
Baseline must use registered sources only

priority_relative_to_proof_packets.rule: Living Community Laboratories are a research category. PP-FF-01 and proof-packet methodology remain the immediate execution priority. Case scaffolds may be captured now; deep baseline work should not displace proof packets.
